question: What does the Matrice 30T manual say about altitude and obstacles during Failsafe RTH?

intake.focus: Matrice 30T Failsafe RTH altitude and obstacle avoidance
intake.reason: Question about behavior during Failsafe Return-to-Home per Matrice 30T manual

brief.short_answer: During Failsafe RTH, the RTH altitude is tied to the Home Point and must be set higher than any obstacle in the area. The aircraft cannot rely on obstacle avoidance during failsafe RTH in insufficient light. The manual does not provide further detail on obstacle avoidance under other conditions.

claims.text: When Failsafe RTH is initiated, the RTH altitude is related to the Home Point; "The RTH altitude is related to the Home Point. Make sure the RTH altitude is higher than any obstacle in the area."
claims.quote: The RTH altitude is related to the Home Point. Make sure the RTH altitude is higher than any obstacle in the area.

claims.text: The aircraft cannot avoid obstacles during failsafe RTH when there is insufficient light; "The aircraft cannot avoid obstacles during failsafe RTH when there is insufficient light."
claims.quote: The aircraft cannot avoid obstacles during failsafe RTH when there is insufficient light.

gaps.text: Manual says RTH altitude relates to Home Point and must be higher than obstacles; lacks guidance on interaction with obstacle avoidance.
No further details on RTH obstacle avoidance under low light or other conditions.
